description: Engagement Phase 3 parity fixture contract. Generated from apps/api/scripts/engagement-phase3-fixture-plan.ts — never hand-edited. Timestamps are descriptors, not literals, so this file is byte-stable and the report-period fixtures stay in the right calendar cycle in any year.

reservedIdentifiers.reason: The capiro_admin role is granted only when the org slug matches this reserved value — apps/api/scripts/bootstrap-capiro-admin.ts CAPIRO_INTERNAL_SLUG. A marker-prefixed slug would produce a tenant whose admin cannot be a Capiro admin, so the impersonation fixture would test nothing.

The one directory contact that exists without the S3 directory snapshot — TEST_DIRECTORY_CONTACT in apps/api/src/directory/directory.service.ts. Reports rows with source="directory" (and therefore every pendingActions count) are reachable only through a directory email match, so this address is what makes that state addressable at all.

states.note: Supported: Client.memoryWall plus client_memory_access grants (apps/api/src/memory/memory-wall.helpers.ts). actor.wallDenied holds no grant.

states.requirement: Capiro Admin impersonation fixture when supported
states.note: Supported: ImpersonationSession rows started by a capiro_admin in the reserved capiro-internal tenant. The expired row is what 3.10 needs to prove expiry clears.
A real row in the second tenant; must read as not-found to every primary actor.
A deleted meeting cannot be seeded; the fixture is an id with no row.
Metadata rows only — no S3 object backs any fixture s3Key.
The second tenant holds zero outreach records, so its list renders the empty state.

The ONLY pre-existing send intent and delivery in the fixture set. 3.7 must therefore assert its external-denial invariants as a DELTA against these declared rows, not as an absolute "zero send intents" count.
clientId stays null; 3.7 asserts no code path fabricates one.

states.requirement: immutable artifact/version and draft audit reads

states.note: client.beta has no meetings in any cycle, so its report renders the empty result.

reportOverview attaches meetings and pendingActions only inside its directory-match loop (engagement.service.ts ~5513), and directory data comes from the S3 snapshot, not the database. The fixture seats the one snapshot-independent directory address on these meetings; without directory access the state is unreachable by ANY database fixture and 3.8 must record it as a coverage limitation rather than a parity failure.
The second tenant holds zero connections, so its Integrations page renders empty.
Stored in syncState as data. Zero IntegrationConnectionToken rows exist, which is the checkable invariant behind "no provider credential".
